name: bench-supported chest stretch
description: A supported chest and shoulder stretch with the hands on a bench and the trunk hinged forward.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy bench and place both hands on its top with straight arms.
Walk your feet back and hinge at the hips so your torso lowers between your arms.
Let the chest sink gently while keeping your neck relaxed and your knees soft.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then slowly walk your feet in and stand up.
